typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		reportingEntity as string,
		{Interface ID} as string,
		{Interface Name} as string,
		Frequency as string,
		{Sent/Received} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Plan Specific Frequency} as string,
		{CIN/Group/Practice Name Label} as string,
		{Date/Time Sent/Received} as string,
		{Records Sent/Received} as long,
		{Records Processed (Target Only)} as string,
		{Error Count (Target Only)} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	\'PHP - BCBSNC\' AS reportingEntity, 		CASE  			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'MED_P%\' THEN \'PLA-I-0193-001\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'MED_I%\' THEN \'PLA-I-0195-001\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'NCPDP%\' THEN \'PLA-I-0121-001\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'DEN%\' THEN \'PLA-I-0245-001\' 			END AS [Interface ID], 		CASE  			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'MED_P%\' THEN \'Professional Historical FFS Claims and MC Encounters from PHP - BCBSNC\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'MED_I%\' THEN \'Institutional Historical FFS Claims and MC Encounters from PHP - BCBSNC\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'NCPDP%\' THEN \'NCPDP Historical FFS Claims and MC Encounters from PHP - BCBSNC\' 			WHEN H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'DEN%\' THEN \'Dental Historical and Ongoing FFS Claims from PHP - BCBSNC to AMH\' 			END AS [Interface Name], 		\'Monthly\' AS Frequency, 		\'Sending Entity\' AS [Sent/Received], 		\'Success\' AS [Status], 		\'Daily\' AS [Plan Specific Frequency], 		F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILE_FILENAME AS [CIN/Group/Practice Name Label], 		FORMAT(CONVERT(DATE,H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME),\'MM/dd/yyyy\') AS [Date/Time Sent/Received], 		F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILE_RECORDCOUNT AS [Records Sent/Received], 		\'(partner leaves blank)\' AS [Records Processed (Target Only)], 		\'(partner leaves blank)\' AS [Error Count (Target Only)]  		 FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.NC_AMH_EXTRACT_HISTORY H	 	INNER JOIN DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.NC_AMH_EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILES F ON H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_IID = F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_IID 		AND H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME BETWEEN ? AND ? 		AND H.EXTRACT_HISTORY_COMPLETION_TIME IS NOT NULL 		AND H.EXTRACT_CONFIG_CODE LIKE \'%A\' 		AND (Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_MEDENCCLMPHD%\'  		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_MEDENCCLMIHD%\' 		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_RXENCHD%\' 		OR Extract_History_File_FileName LIKE \'NCMT_DENCLMHD%\') 	INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT_RECIPIENT_CODE,EXTRACT_RECIPIENT_NAME FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.NC_EXTRACT_RECIPIENTS) R ON F.EXTRACT_HISTORY_FILE_RECIPIENT = R.EXTRACT_RECIPIENT_CODE ORDER BY R.EXTRACT_RECIPIENT_NAME,[Date/Time Sent/Received],[Interface Name]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DataExchangeLogTables
DataExchangeLogTables derive(reportingEntity_Unicode = toString(reportingEntity),
		Frequency_Unicode = toString(Frequency),
		Status_Unicode = toString(Status),
		{Sent/Received_Unicode} = toString({Sent/Received})) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MonitoringReport
